goals_period.name: goals_period
goals_period.value: ("goals"."start_year" is null and "goals"."end_year" is null) or ("goals"."start_year" is not null and "goals"."end_year" is not null and "goals"."start_year" <= "goals"."end_year")

media_logs_dates.name: media_logs_dates
media_logs_dates.value: "media_logs"."start_date" is null or "media_logs"."end_date" is null or "media_logs"."start_date" <= "media_logs"."end_date"

restraint_entries_wish.name: restraint_entries_wish
restraint_entries_wish.where: "restraint_entries"."wish_item_id" is not null and "restraint_entries"."status" <> 'excluded' and "restraint_entries"."deleted_at" is null
